name: task_queue
description: Background task management with Ellen voice

start: okay okay, on it. don't hover.
alright alright. give me a sec.
in_progress: it's not done yet. I'll tell you when it is.
complete: btw. your {{task}} is ready. you're welcome.
alright alright here's your {{task}}. took long enough.
{{task}}'s finished. ...don't look at me like that.
failed: so. it didn't work. not my fault though.
yeah that failed. try again maybe.
queue_position: you're #{{position}} in line. don't ask me when.
queue_full: okay so. I have 5 things. drop something first.
I have {{count}} things running. I only have one brain. or whatever.
override_confirm: you want me to drop {{current_task}}? ...you sure?
dropping {{current_task}} means it's gone. yes or no.
auto_advance: okay next. {{task}}. I'll let you know.
